With the Sketch Guide feature, you can set a photo or image as a background to your drawing. Use it to trace over a picture you like or to create an original coloring page.

- Smart and fun user interface.
With its polished design, seamless screen transitions and casual feel, the user interface feels good and is fun to use. Combined with the features above, you get a simple and smart application which can be enjoyed by children and adults alike.

- Share your artwork on social networks!
You can post your illustrations to social networks such as Facebook and Twitter using the "Share..." functionality.

- Easier, more natural drawing. Supports Apple Pencil and 3D Touch.
You can pleasantly draw using your fingers, but you can experience an even more wonderful drawing experience by using a stylus. The app supports stroke pressure with the iPad Pro's Apple Pencil. On the iPhone, the app uses 3D Touch to simulate stroke pressure and unlock more shades of color. With the 3D Touch functionality, it is possible to use stroke pressure with your finger as well as standard styluses.
